low.title: Low level of dependence
low.text: Your body's dependence on nicotine looks relatively low. Even so, habits and triggers can be strong; the camp's main job is working with them.

mid.title: Moderate level of dependence
mid.text: Your nicotine dependence is moderate. You may feel withdrawal symptoms in the first days; they're temporary, and in the camp you'll learn ways to cope with them.

high.title: High level of dependence
high.text: Your nicotine dependence is high. This isn't a judgement, it's information: getting support while you quit makes it easier. Behavioural tools and professional support together give the best results.

hsiInfo: The Heaviness of Smoking Index is based on two questions: how many cigarettes you smoke a day and how soon after waking you light your first. It gives a score from 0 to 6 and is widely used around the world to quickly assess nicotine dependence. It isn't a diagnosis.
medication: Quit-smoking medicines can increase your chances of quitting. In Türkiye they're given free of charge at quit-smoking clinics if the doctor sees fit; you can call ALO 171 for an appointment. Elsewhere, ask your doctor or pharmacist. If you're pregnant or have heart disease or a psychiatric diagnosis, talk to your doctor first.
under18: If you're under 18, in Türkiye you can call ALO 171 to be referred to quit-smoking clinics that serve under-18s; elsewhere, talk to your doctor. You can use all the behavioural tools in the camp.

triggers.label: When I'm talking on the phone

relapseNote: Having tried before means you've learned what makes it hard, not that you can't do it. Based on these answers, we'll bring the relevant skill lessons to the front.

methods.label: Choose a quit day
methods.desc: The recommended way: set a date 3 to 14 days from now and prepare until then.

methods.label: Quit by cutting down
methods.desc: Cut down a little every week for 2–4 weeks, then a quit day at the end. Cutting down isn't the goal; it's a bridge.

methods.label: I've already quit
methods.desc: Enter when your last cigarette was, and the camp will start from the right phase for you.

alo171.title: ALO 171 Quit Smoking Helpline (Türkiye)
alo171.text: Available 24/7 in Türkiye. Free from landlines; calls from mobiles may be charged at your operator's rate. You can call for counselling, a dependence assessment and an appointment at a quit-smoking clinic.
alo171.save: We suggest saving the number in your phone's contacts as "ALO 171"; then it's easy to call in a hard moment.

phases.title: Preparation
phases.text: Until your quit day: a mission every day, a smoking diary and a short skill lesson.

phases.title: Quit Day
phases.text: A special checklist and the "not a single puff" rule.

phases.title: Critical Week
phases.text: Days 1–7: the most intensive support; two short checks a day.

phases.title: Strengthening
phases.text: Days 8–30: daily missions and a weekly review.

phases.title: Staying Power
phases.text: Days 31–90: a few missions a week and relapse prevention.

phases.title: Freedom
phases.text: After day 90: graduation and monthly checks.
